messages.content: Hi there—Jamie here at GoldenFoods. We craft gourmet kibble, wet food, treats, even subscription boxes just for Golden Retrievers.
We sell nationwide through indie pet boutiques and big retail chains; I’m targeting a 40 % increase in physical-store coverage this year.
Right now leads pour in from trade shows, our website, social media, referrals, and outbound calls, but spreadsheets are killing our follow-up speed.
Typical lead fields I log: product interest, estimated monthly volume in pounds, region, and preferred contact method.
Our sales pipeline mirrors Salesforce defaults—Qualification, Proposal/Price Quote, Negotiation/Review, and Closed Won.
Any quote with a discount above 15 % needs my sign-off, so I’d like an automated approval step for that.
Dashboards I need: lead-to-opportunity conversion by region, average days to convert, and a store-coverage heat map.
Every new opportunity should auto-create two tasks: send a sample pack within three days and schedule a pricing call within ten.
Please be sure email replies log back to Salesforce so we can keep response times under 24 hours.
